messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired: PD#12345 - inference-queue-backlog-high in us-west-2. queue_length=3124 (>3000 for 5m) and consumer_throughput down ~40%.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert created and routed to escalation policy `inference-oncall`. Auto-assigned to @alice.

alice: Acked. I'm oncall and looking. Pulling metrics + recent deploys.

alice: Quick snapshot: backlog=3124, inflight tokens spiking, avg latency p95=1.8s -> 3.6s in us-west-2. Autoscaler pending_provisions=18, provider errors=rate_limited.

charlie: I'm nearby, taking lead from alice. Handing off oncall to me in 2m.

alice: Passing context: looks like provider spot returns stalled; autoscaler requests queued at provider layer. No recent deploys in last 2h.

charlie: Starting manual mitigation: allocating dedicated nodes and increasing HPA floor. Running commands now:
```
redwoodctl allocate --pool inference-dedicated-us-west-2 --gpus 8 --reason "pd-queue-backlog"
kubectl patch hpa inference-hotpath -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'
```

incident-bot: Automatic fallback enabled: model-variant `gpt-slim` will be served for requests >30s waiting.

eli: Provider logs show API 429 on instance allocation: `provider-api: rate limit exceeded` — backlog of provisioning requests building. ETA from provider support ~10-12m.

charlie: Submitted manual allocation to provider (above). Also enabling traffic bleed to another region for non-enterprise traffic:
```
routingctl reroute --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --traffic 20% --scope non-enterprise
```

dana: CS note: seeing a handful of enterprise error reports (enterprise keys) with 500s around the same window. I'm starting outreach to top 3 affected accounts.

alice: Customer impact estimate: hosted-api us-west-2 saw ~1.8% of requests fail with 500s during spike, latency for ~7% of requests elevated. Marking impact as partial for hosted customers in region.

charlie: Nodes are starting to come up; provisioning confirmations rolling in. Monitoring backlog.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD#12345 acknowledged by alice. Escalation scheduled to charlie in 9m if not resolved.

charlie: After manual scale + reroute backlog down to ~1.2k (10m after actions). Throughput ramping back to normal.

dana: CS: outreach update — two customers acknowledged transient errors, no escalations so far.

alice: Great. I'm keeping a 30m watch window before closure. Adding runbook notes and tagging followups.

charlie: Root cause hypothesis: provider-side rate limiting for spot/ephemeral allocations created provisioning queue -> autoscaler requests stuck. Mitigation: temporary dedicated pool + regional bleed + add provider quota request.

incident-bot: PD#12345 entered monitoring state.

alice: Will open a follow-up ticket to request provider quota bump and add autoscaler retry/backoff improvements to postmortem. @charlie to own postmortem.

charlie: Confirming backlog continues to drop, p95 latency returning to baseline. Preparing writeup.

pagerduty-bot: PD#12345 resolved and closed by alice.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Summary: provider allocation rate limits caused autoscaler lag and queue buildup in us-west-2; manual scale + traffic reroute mitigated customer impact. Postmortem assigned to charlie. Severity: high.
